8.3.5.3 EcuM_ClearWakeupEvent
[SWS_EcuM_02828] Definition of API function EcuM_ClearWakeupEvent
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_00004
⌈
Service Name
EcuM_ClearWakeupEvent
Syntax
void EcuM_ClearWakeupEvent (
EcuM_WakeupSourceType sources
)
Service ID [hex]
0x16
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non-Reentrant, Non-Interruptible
Parameters (in)
sources
Events to be cleared
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Clears wakeup events.
Available via
EcuM.h
⌋
[SWS_EcuM_02683]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_00003, SRS_ModeMgm_00004
⌈EcuM_ClearWakeupEvent clears all pending events passed as a bit set in the sources
in parameter (EcuM_WakeupSourceType bitmask) from the internal pending wakeup
events variable, the internal validated events variable and the internal expired events
variable.⌋
See also section 7.6.3 Internal Representation of Wakeup States.
[SWS_EcuM_02807]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_00003, SRS_ModeMgm_00004, SRS_BSW_00333
⌈EcuM_ClearWakeupEvent shall be callable from interrupt context, from OS context
and an OS-free context.⌋
Integration note: The clearing of wakeup sources shall take place during ECU shut-
down prior to the call of Dem_Shutdown() and NvM_WriteAll(). This can be achieved
by configuring BswMRules in the BswM module containing BswMActions of type
BswMUserCallout with their BswMUserCalloutFunction parameter set to "EcuM_Clear
WakeupEvents(<sources>)".
Hereby <sources> needs to be derived from the Ecu
